profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Computer Science professional, known for teamwork and a positive can-do attitude, focused and reliable.  Strong work ethic; able to acquire new technical skills and knowledge quickly. Highly adaptable, strong organizational and presentation skills. Practical experience through technical internship projects and part-time work through college. Attained Eagle Scout rank at age 15. Managed a $1,200 public service project to repair and upgrade a local school recess play area. Graduating in four years and debt free.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted with Aetna
●	 Maintained multiple applications by performing coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the application development process
●	 Performed application upgrades from older versions of .Net Framework as well as planning the transition of applications to .Net Core
●	Work closely with Product Owners to provide project estimates based on customer experience, features, and envisioned solutions
●	Used PL SQL to write and integrate procedures
●	 Debugged existing Java-based SOAP API
●	 Participate in iteration planning to help create solid backlog with technical input in close partnership with product team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Responsible for development of Meter Data Management commercial software using an ASP.Net Core for the service layer with RESTful APIs to integrate with that Angular 12 Frontend UI, Oracle Database for the backend, and Docker for deployment 
Lead Scrum Team and organized sprint planning meetings, daily standups, and retrospectives
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · ASP.NET Core · Oracle Database · Scrum · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Development of Internal Claim tools using AngularJS, C#, and VB.Net using Scrum methodology 
•	Creation of demo project displaying the benefits of the Angular4 framework and Microsoft Azure Architecture
•	Developed and maintained state compliant regulatory web using Javascript and VB.Net
•	Built data transformation using proprietary ETL tool (Astera Centerprise)

positions.title: Student Worker (GIS/AppDev)
positions.description:
Extensive editing work with ArcGIS.
Worked on Georgia's Natural, Archaeological, and Historic Resources GIS application locating historical sites and assisted with the maintenance of the GNAHRGIS code base.
Edited tax parcels to support a county tax assessor
Increased internal hourly reporting efficiency by ~75%
Researched and developed new Qlik Sense visualization tools.
Created an automated Data retrieval tool, increased efficiency by 80%

positions.title: Web/Mobile Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Responsible for development of multiple commercial websites
•	Development of Android Mobile Application
•	Assisted Local Non-Profit with website construction

positions.title: Customer Service/Dispatcher
positions.description:
•	Handled the most calls of the dispatch center.
•	Monitored progress of delivery routes and assisted contracted drivers with routing and scheduling deliveries.
•	Resolved any customer issues, complaints and answered questions. Handled billing questions as well as responsible for billing and data entry tasks.

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk
positions.description: Bag customer’s items and place in their cart.  Retrieve carts from the store’s parking lot; maintaining cleanliness of the store; returning non-purchased items to proper shelf location; assisting customers with their questions; and obtaining price verification on products.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Participated in multiple volunteer duties spanning several years. Lead own Eagle Scout project at age 15.
Held leadership positions of: Troop Chaplin, Assistant Patrol Leader, Patrol Leader

•	Responsible for major update of church website
•	Developed web-responsive tools for interacting between the church and congregation

projects.title: Global Information Systems
projects.description: Earned “A” grade on a research project involving the creating of a web-based application for the use of sentiment analysis on location based “tweets”. Involved advance API integration and use of industry standard technologies: PHP, Node,js, and HTML

projects.title: Data Mining
projects.description: Earned “A” grade on a research paper based on advance statistical analysis of a large data set of traffic fatalities. Used advance machine learning algorithms to predict fatal collisions.
